title: Delete a test lead
content_data:
Use this endpoint to delete an existing test lead. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/pages/leads/mock/delete/|/v1.3/page/lead/mock/delete/| |Request parameter data type |`advertiser_id`:number
`library_id `:number
`page_id`:number|`advertiser_id`: string
`library_id `:string
`page_id`:string| ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/page/lead/mock/delete/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field|Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| |Content-Type {Required}|string| The content type of the request. For this endpoint, use `application/json`.| ``` **Parameters** ```xtable | Field | Type | Description | |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {+Conditional}|string| Required when the test lead is under an ad account.

Advertiser ID. | |library_id {+Conditional}|string|Required when the test lead is under a form library of a Business Center.

ID of a form library.| |lead_id {Required}|string| The ID of the test lead that you want to delete.

To obtain the ID of the existing test lead, use [/page/lead/mock/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739048460493826). | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl -H "Access-Token:xxx" -H "Content-Type:application/json" -X POST \ -d '{ "advertiser_id": "ADVERTISER_ID", "lead_id": "LEAD_ID" }' \ https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/page/lead/mock/delete/ (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field|Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number|The response code. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |data |object|The returned data. | |request_id |string|The unique ID of the request, which uniquely identifies a request. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "message": "OK", "code": 0, "data": {} } (/code); ```
